title: shahcompbio/nf-pindel pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

patient.errorMessage: Patient identifier must be provided and cannot contain spaces

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

status.errorMessage: Status must be 0 for a normal sample or 1 for a tumour sample

bam.errorMessage: BAM/CRAM file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bam' or '.cram'

bai.errorMessage: BAM/CRAM index must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bai' or '.crai'

bas.errorMessage: Optional BAM statistics file, co-located with the BAM, with extension '.bas'
